WoW: Forever

Priest

Priest is a cloth-wearing caster with two healing specialisations and one ranged damage specialisation. Before you pick a spec, know that Mind FlayMind FlayLevel 20 · Spell · Shadow · Rank 1 of 6CastInstantCost45 ManaRange20 yd rangeDuration3 secAssault the target's mind with Shadow energy, causing 63 Shadow damage over 3 sec and slowing their movement speed by 50%. is talent-only, as it was in Classic. It is a Shadow talent, gated on 10 points in that tree and so on level 20. A Holy or Discipline Priest does not have it in practice.

WoW: Forever · Updated November 13, 2026 · Client build 1.60.1.70938 · Null Ossuary

A guide to the live game, levels 1 to 60. Forever launched on November 4, 2026 and this page was checked against client 1.60.1.70938 on November 13. Spell numbers, training levels and the talent tree are read from the client. Blizzard's Priest Class Deep Dive of September 30, its November 2 development notes and its launch hotfixes outrank the client and the guide sites wherever they disagree. Blizzard has hotfixed Priest three times since launch: November 9 (Fear WardFear WardLevel 20 · Spell · HolyCastInstantCost100 ManaRange30 yd rangeCooldown180 sec cooldownDuration180 secWards the friendly target against Fear. The next Fear effect used against the target will fail, using up the ward. Lasts 180 sec. no longer breaks ShadowformShadowformSpell · ShadowCastInstantCost40% of base ManaCooldown1.5 sec cooldownDurationUntil cancelledAssume Shadowform, increasing your Shadow damage by 10%, reducing the Mana cost of all Shadow spells by 50%, increasing the critical strike damage bonus of your Shadow spells by 100%, and reducing Physical damage taken by you by 15%. However, you may not cast healing spells while in this form., and Power InfusionPower InfusionTalentCastInstantCost20% of base ManaRange30 yd rangeCooldown180 sec cooldownDuration15 secInfuses the target with power, increasing their spell damage and healing done by 20% for 15 sec. persists on allies), November 10 and November 11 (small fixes, listed on the spec pages). Advice on how to play is attributed to the site that publishes it. No raid opens before December 9, 2026, so nothing here rests on a raid log. Where a tooltip differs from the text, go by the text: tooltips can lag a hotfix.

The published advice for soloing is to level with Shadow talents and respec to heal. Icy Veins' Discipline and Holy guides both say it in the same words: "it is a better idea to primarily use Shadow talents until you're able to get into group content." Wowhead's Holy levelling page says the same and adds that Discipline levels faster than Holy.

A second published route runs the other way. Icy Veins and Wowhead both describe levelling on MeditationMeditationTalent · Rank 3 of 3CastInstantAllows 50% of your Mana regeneration to continue while casting. in the Discipline tree until 40, then respeccing into Shadow the moment ShadowformShadowformSpell · ShadowCastInstantCost40% of base ManaCooldown1.5 sec cooldownDurationUntil cancelledAssume Shadowform, increasing your Shadow damage by 10%, reducing the Mana cost of all Shadow spells by 50%, increasing the critical strike damage bonus of your Shadow spells by 100%, and reducing Physical damage taken by you by 15%. However, you may not cast healing spells while in this form. is available. The Shadow page has the point order.

The published ratings sit on the three spec pages, each alongside the caveat that the levelling number measures solo kill speed and nothing else.

This is not a permanent commitment. A respec is a visit to a class trainer in a major city. Icy Veins puts the first one at 1 gold, rising each time you do it. Dual Specialization is bought from your class trainer at level 40 for 50 gold (Wowhead's report, November 11; Blizzard's own post gives the level and no price). Your mount is also a level-40 purchase.

Is Priest for you?

Play Priest if you want to be the person keeping everyone alive, and you are happy watching health bars rather than the fight.

Strengths

  • A shield that prevents damage rather than repairing it, and a Power Word: ShieldPower Word: ShieldLevel 6 · Spell · Holy · Rank 1 of 10CastInstantCost45 ManaRange40 yd rangeCooldown4 sec cooldownDuration30 secDraws on the soul of the party member to shield them, absorbing 48 damage. Lasts 30 sec. While the shield holds, spellcasting will not be interrupted by damage. Once shielded, the target cannot be shielded again for 15 sec. of equal or higher rank can replace one already on the target
  • Fear WardFear WardLevel 20 · Spell · HolyCastInstantCost100 ManaRange30 yd rangeCooldown180 sec cooldownDuration180 secWards the friendly target against Fear. The next Fear effect used against the target will fail, using up the ward. Lasts 180 sec. is baseline for every race from level 20, so no race is locked out of it
  • Dual Specialization from level 40 carries a damage spec and a healing spec at once

Weaknesses

  • Icy Veins' headings for the two healing specs while levelling: "No AoE, Struggles To Solo Level" and "Pitiful AoE and Lackluster Damage"
  • No movement ability at all. Wowhead and Icy Veins both list it, and your mount is level 40
  • Desperate PrayerDesperate PrayerLevel 10 · Spell · Holy · Rank 1 of 7CastInstantCooldown600 sec cooldownInstantly heals the caster for 146 to 181. is Dwarf-only now, so most Priests have no instant self-heal

New to this class?

Is the rotation simple? Yes: a damage-over-time spell, a nuke, then your wand.

Is it forgiving? Not solo. Cloth armour, and Mana is the limit: Wowhead's Holy page has you drinking every couple of pulls without a wand finish.

What carries you while levelling? However, you may not cast healing spells while in this form. at 40.

Does it need a group? No, but both healing specs are published as group specs. Solo, the advice is Shadow talents.

Which race

Read this section in proportion. Race is the smallest of the choices on this page, well behind spec, gear and knowing your rotation, and no race is a wrong answer for levelling (ours, not a source's). Racials decide things in PvP, and specifically the ones that break crowd control: Will of the ForsakenWill of the ForsakenTalentCastInstantCooldown120 sec cooldownDuration0.1 secInstantly removes all Charm, Fear and Sleep effects. (Human, stuns), Escape ArtistEscape ArtistTalentCastInstantCooldown120 sec cooldownDuration3 secInstantly escape the effects of any movement impairing effect and gain immunity to those effects for 3 sec. Quality of life

  • The wand is the levelling mechanic. Wand skill is default, so a wand works the moment you loot one, and Wand SpecializationWand SpecializationTalent · Rank 2 of 2CastInstantIncreases your damage with Wands by 25%. is now two points instead of five. Wowhead's levelling pages name the Enchanting-made Lesser Magic WandLesser Magic WandItem at level 5 and Greater Magic WandGreater Magic WandItem at 13.
  • Wanding does not stop your Mana regeneration. Spirit regeneration restarts five seconds after your last spell that cost Mana, and a wand costs none. Both sites give the same reason for finishing every kill with it.
  • Re-drag your action bars, or use macros. Nearly every even level brings a new rank of something, and the bars do not update themselves. New spells do not place themselves on your bars either. A /cast Spell Name macro always fires the highest rank you know.
  • Low ranks lose nothing on talent procs. Talents that trigger from your spells no longer have a lower chance when you cast a low rank, so downranking a heal or a nuke costs you no talent procs.
  • Training costs are flattened. Blizzard puts the cost of every class ability from 1 to 60 at 206 to 207 gold for every class, with abilities learned at the same level costing the same. The Priest's race-specific spells are the exception.
  • Trainers are in starting zones and capitals only. Wowhead's levelling guide lists them; there is none out in the levelling zones.
  • Tailoring and Enchanting. Both sites recommend the pair. The good Forever crafted cloth pieces are bind-on-pickup, so you can only make them for yourself.

At level 60

Published builds now exist for all three specs. Wowhead and Icy Veins each publish level-60 raid and dungeon builds, and WoWSims carries a preset for each spec. The spec pages give them with their dates. All of them predate any raid: Barrow Deeps, Hyjal Summit and Onyxia's Lair open on December 9, 2026, so no raid log exists to test them against.
